source_category: # Overture Place Categories (taxonomy.hierarchy labels) to Trippr categories.
# A place takes the rule for its most specific label: taxonomy.primary first
# ancestor in taxonomy.hierarchy from deepest to the top level. "exclude" drops the place on
# purpose (not a trip activity); a place with no matching rule is "unmapped" and also dropped
# and the run report shows the unmapped share. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Whole top-level groups that are not trip activities
